notes.title: Sexbot 1.034
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

I have added in two new language translations for German and Japanese!

I have also fixed up multiple issues with Alexa's Submissive route walkthrough. Corrected scenes that were not triggering, as well as adding additional prompts where required. 

I have changed the requirements of Alexa's day 5 night visit, so they can be accessed on her route more easily. The requirements for other characters for this event have not changed.

Thank you for all your support, Sexbot II recalibrated is well under way, and I can't wait to bring it to Steam!

notes.title: Sexbot 1.02 - DLC compatibility
notes.content: This update just adds compatibility to handle the DLC. You should notice no changes to your game without the DLC. If you do, please report it. Thank you!

notes.title: Sexbot 1.01 - Gameplay tweak
notes.content:
Previously: if you wanted to take Bailey (or other side characters) to a movie, you had to have met Ashley  (or next girl in line) at school. This was done so you knew who they were for later events in the game.

Now: to take Bailey to a movie, you just need to have talked to her at school. This should make the early gameplay smoother, and less arbitrarily confusing. The default name will be used for a character if you haven't met and renamed them.
